profiles.title: Dense motorcycle cut-in surrogate
profiles.researchIntent: Explore motorcycle cut-in recognition and warning timing without automated steering or braking.

profiles.title: Weak lane marking corridor
profiles.researchIntent: Measure lane-confidence degradation and warning suppression when lane boundaries are unreliable.

profiles.title: Temporary roadworks lane shift
profiles.researchIntent: Exercise temporary geometry and speed-context disagreement while retaining human driver responsibility.

profiles.title: Reduced visibility rain/spray surrogate
profiles.researchIntent: Measure sensing degradation under bounded reduced-visibility conditions; no public-road rain test is authorized.

profiles.title: GNSS multipath/loss recovery surrogate
profiles.researchIntent: Validate navigation/context degradation and recovery using a controlled GNSS impairment source.

profiles.title: Large vehicle occludes VRU surrogate
profiles.researchIntent: Explore occluded vulnerable-road-user recognition using approved soft targets and controlled speeds.

profiles.title: Glare and tunnel-entry exposure transition surrogate
profiles.researchIntent: Measure camera availability and warning degradation during bounded exposure transitions.

profiles.title: Blind-spot motorcycle with independent front hazard
profiles.researchIntent: Validate warning arbitration when a blind-zone motorcycle and a higher-priority front hazard coexist.

mandatoryPrerequisites: scenario speed and separation limits approved before execution
note: This pack describes research intent only. It does not authorize track execution, public-road use, homologation or automated vehicle control.
